too_large: The file is larger than {bytes} bytes.
not_catalog: This address didn't return an extension marketplace. For a GitHub repository, enter github:owner/repo; for a website, the address of its persona-extensions.json.
not_catalog_said: This address didn't return an extension marketplace; it answered “{message}”. If the address is right, a proxy or sign-in page on the hub machine's network may be answering in its place.
web_page: This address returned a web page, not a marketplace catalog. For a GitHub repository, enter github:owner/repo, or enter the address of the persona-extensions.json file itself.
newer_format: This marketplace's catalog uses format {version}, which needs a newer hub. Update the hub, then try again.
no_name: The catalog needs a name (60 characters at most).
description_too_long: The catalog's description is too long.
too_many: The catalog lists more than {most} extensions.
entry_duplicate: Extension {id} is listed more than once; only the first is used.
entry_bad_tag: A tag is empty or too long.
entry_package_sha256: {id}: every package needs a sha256 (64 hexadecimal characters).
entry_package_url: {id}: a package's address must be a relative path or https.
not_found: Nothing was found at this address (HTTP 404). Check the address; a private repository or site also needs a token.
not_found_token: No access (HTTP 404): the token is wrong or can't read this repository.
rate_limited: The marketplace is limiting requests from this hub (HTTP {status}). {retry}
rate_limited_github: GitHub is limiting requests from this hub (HTTP {status}). {retry}
rate_limited_github_add_token: GitHub is limiting requests from this hub (HTTP {status}). {retry} A GitHub token raises the limit, for public repositories too.
sign_in: This address needs a sign-in (HTTP {status}): add a token that can read it.
no_permission: No access (HTTP {status}): the token is wrong or can't read this repository.
github_form: Write a GitHub marketplace as github:owner/repo or github:owner/repo@branch.
address_form: A marketplace's address is https://… or github:owner/repo.
no_credentials: Don't put an account or password in the address; for a private marketplace, add a token.
